name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The general's Rune-etched Axe has Rend 2.

name: Champion of Raids
text: In your charge phase, another friendly unit wholly within 12" of the general can re-roll its charge rolls for the rest of the turn.

name: Fell Ritualist
text: While the general is on the battlefield, each time you draw battle tactic cards you may draw 1 extra, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
